    String boundary squares in the finite module category #

    The explicit string-module boundary complexes are first proved exact in the ambient functor category. This file bundles their maps in the category of finite-dimensional linear modules and reflects exactness along the faithful inclusion. Thus the chosen middle term is a literal binary biproduct in the finite module category, as required by the almost-split argument.
